data_as_of: Futures, VIX, 10Y, DXY, WTI, gold, BTC: Yahoo Finance v7 quotes ~7:43 a.m. CT (Yahoo futures quotes delayed ~10 min). Pre-market prices/volumes: StockAnalysis.com ~7:50–7:55 a.m. CT. Cash closes are Thursday Nov 5 (Yahoo).
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures rebound about 1.3% as chips bounce after Thursday's AI rout, while Dow futures fall about 1% and October payrolls beat at +165K.
drivers: Thursday was the worst day since April 2025: the S&P 500 fell 4.4%, the Nasdaq Composite 5.5% (into correction) and the Nasdaq-100 6.4%, with all 11 sectors lower as investors priced in slower AI data-center buildouts after the Democratic midterm sweep; reports put the Magnificent 7 loss near $1 trillion and the Philadelphia semiconductor index down about 12%. The selloff spread to Asia overnight: the Nikkei fell about 5.9% into a bear market and the Kospi more than 6%, with the Hang Seng down about 1.3%. This morning chips are bouncing (SOXX +5%, MU +8%, AMD +8%, SNDK +10%, NVDA +4%), lifting Nasdaq-100 futures about 1.3%, while Dow futures are down about 1%. October payrolls at 7:30 a.m. CT came in at +165K vs about 55–65K expected, unemployment fell to 4.1% from 4.2%, and September was revised up to +60K from +29K; the 10Y yield rose to about 4.88% and the dollar firmed. Earnings drive big single-stock gaps: Cloudflare, Airbnb, IREN, TeraWulf, Oklo and Firefly are up 11–20%, while DraftKings (−28%) and Atlassian (−15%) slide; VIX is still about 27. Gold is down about 1.4%, WTI is near $91 and Bitcoin is about $76K.
